summary: Vesta filed a 6-K announcing the closing of the over-allotment option from its previously completed follow-on offering. Underwriters purchased an additional 7,749,200 ADSs (each representing 10 common shares) at $34.62/ADS, raising ~$26.8M gross. The sale was on the same terms as the initial offering. Proceeds will fund growth strategy. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
